def find_vulnerabilities_fixed(vulnerabilities: Dict[str, Any], fixes: List
    [Fix]) ->List[Vulnerability]:
    fixed_vulnerabilities = []
    
    # Create a set of fixed package names and versions for quick lookup
    fixed_packages = set()
    for fix in fixes:
        if fix.status == 'APPLIED':
            fixed_packages.add((fix.package, fix.previous_version))
    
    # Check each vulnerability to see if it was fixed
    for vuln in vulnerabilities.values():
        if hasattr(vuln, 'pkg') and vuln.pkg:
            pkg_name = vuln.pkg.name
            version = vuln.analyzed_version
            if (pkg_name, version) in fixed_packages:
                fixed_vulnerabilities.append(vuln)
    
    return fixed_vulnerabilities
